permit_summary.note: DBI holds 28 permits for this parcel, most of them tenant improvements on individual floors. The timeline shows the 24 largest by stated cost, plus the earliest on file; the DBI query in the sources below returns all 28. 1 of them are nominal $1 street-space or sidewalk permits.

hook: A 1947 store-and-flats building at the corner of Innes and Earl, burnt out by 2007.

historic_survey.note: A two-story wood-frame mixed-use building, stucco below and rustic channel siding above, five bays along Earl Street, recorded in 2007 with its storefront and upper windows boarded up after a fire. One of two mixed commercial and residential buildings the survey counted in India Basin. The city carries neither number the survey used for it: the parcel is addressed 740 Earl Street today. The survey recorded every building in its area built in or before 1962 on a Primary Record, and evaluated the pre-1939 ones on Building, Structure and Object Records; a Primary Record carries no status code and no eligibility finding.
